title: Integration output
description: What the integration reviewer returns. It adds no findings and judges no code: it collects what the specialists found, names true duplicates, and counts. Contract: docs/agents/review-contract.md

summary.description: The review body. Counts by severity, repeated defects named as one issue with N sites, and what was not reviewed. Mechanical, not an assessment of the change.

duplicates.description: Findings that say the same thing about the same code. Everything not listed here renders. May be empty, and usually is.

id.description: The finding to drop. Id minted by the run.

duplicateOf.description: The finding it duplicates, which is kept.

reason.description: Why these two are the same finding. A different line or a different file is never a reason.
